issue: T90A scope markings collapsed, mask oversized and status outside viewport
root_causes: AUI 1.2.8 CssLength ignores multiplication factors in calc(), e.g. calc(10px * .92) resolves to 10px
Position expressions put the old caption at (-100,-450) and status at y=1283.8 in a 1600x900 document
MoLang comparisons of ammunition label strings did not distinguish empty from AP in the native fixture
fixes: Fixed local marker coordinates and one bound transform scale
Percentage based caption and status anchors
Opaque outside/transparent circular center via native SVG decoder; removed large CSS shadow
Direct chambered ammunition label; real state classes for ready/reloading/empty
Minimum low-zoom reticle size for legibility
